figurative_meaning_en: To flee quickly or run away in haste
similar_in_english: To make a dash for it
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিপদের মুখে সে দৌড় মেরে পালিয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: The thief made a run for it when he saw the police.
He bolted from the scene upon facing danger.
note: This idiom is widely used in colloquial Bengali to describe hasty escape, reflecting everyday survival instincts in Bengali culture.
